product_metadata.title: EasyFit Solid Wrap Around Easy On/Off Dust Ruffle 18-Inch Drop Bedskirt, Twin/Full, Black
features: EASY SET UP - Stop wrestling with your mattress! Thanks to the innovative easy-stretch design, say goodnight to lifting a heavy mattress to simply change your bed skirt.
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED - Suitable for any bed size and offers an 18-Inch drop.
STYLE - Hide unsightly box springs and bed frames and enjoy stylish Baratta stitch. Double embroidery pattern offers a beautiful and elegant aesthetic.
PREMIUM QUALITY - Masterly crafted 68% Polyester & 32% Cotton bedskirt.
description: Changing your bed skirt has never been so quick and easy!  This beautiful bed skirt adds the perfect touch of charm and finished style, without having to lift a heavy mattress. No more back-breaking lifting. The easy-stretch design allows it to slip effortlessly over your mattress and around your box spring. The Easy Fit bed skirt’s innovative design and versatile style adjusted to fit any bed size and offers a 18” drop.  Hide unsightly box springs and bed frames with the delicate eyelet or classic solid style. Available in Twin/Full and Queen/King. Poly/Cotton Blend. Machine washable.
